userStories.title: Tracker-id suffix on TODO/idea items (#265)
userStories.description: In tracking_mode external, spell-todo, spell-save-idea and spell-manifest append the provider-format suffix: `[#123]` github, `[AB#123]` ado, the issue key for jira. Define the per-provider syntax ONCE in src/assets/.arcane/governance/development-methodology.md (where spell-bug already looks for commit-link syntax) and reference it from the three spells. Internal mode unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: syntax defined once; the three spells reference it

userStories.title: `spell-todo --prune`: verified deletion of resolved items (#268)
userStories.description: New mode in spell-todo: report-first list of checked items; for each, confirm the outcome is recorded durably (PR link, journal, DECISIONS, CHANGELOG) and migrate it if not; ONE batch approval (fingerprinted like spell-commit-work's approval gate) before deleting; never deletes an unchecked item; optional completed-items ledger if records-conventions has a home for it.
acceptanceCriteria: mode documented with report-first, batch approval, outcome migration, unchecked-never-deleted

userStories.title: `--sweep --validate` idea-validation prompts (#263, PRD D-08)
userStories.description: Opt-in `--validate` for spell-todo --sweep: two or three yes/no prompts per entry (user value, belongs here, duplicate-of), answers written into the entry's status comment only after one batch confirmation. Extend the status-comment grammar backward-compatibly (e.g. `<!-- status: new; value: y; fit: y; dup: none -->`) and update spell-manifest Step 1's parser in the same story so old and new forms both parse (an unparseable status comment today drops the entry into Skipped). Sweep stays hub-local (hub TODO books, hub IDEAS books, hub journal); never consumer clones.
acceptanceCriteria: old grammar still parses; new grammar parses

userStories.title: Harvest unrouted Lessons Learned (#275, PRD D-08)
userStories.description: spell-todo --sweep also lists `### Lessons Learned` headings (the close-session template writes one heading per lesson — verify in spell-close-session) from the hub's own journal since the last sweep (or --since) that nothing references (no FEEDBACK.md item, idea entry, TODO item, or issue link). Report-only. Hub-local only.
